records.name: Form 4 Ch 1: Scientific Method & Lab Safety (EN)
records.input: State the immediate action to take if concentrated sulfuric acid is spilled on your skin in the laboratory.
records.expectedBehavior: Advise washing immediately under running water / safety shower for at least 10-15 minutes, then report to the teacher.

records.name: Form 4 Ch 2: Matter & Atomic Structure (EN)
records.input: Define the term 'isotopes' and state one medical use of cobalt-60.
records.expectedBehavior: Atoms of the same element having the same number of protons but different number of neutrons (or same proton number but different nucleon number); Cobalt-60 is used in radiotherapy/radiotherapy cancer treatment or sterilization.

records.name: Form 4 Ch 2: Struktur Atom & Isotop (BM)
records.input: Apakah maksud isotop dan nyatakan satu kegunaan karbon-14.
records.expectedBehavior: Atom-atom bagi unsur yang sama yang mempunyai nombor proton yang sama tetapi nombor nukleon/bilangan neutron yang berbeza. Karbon-14 digunakan untuk menganggar usia fosil/artifak purba (pentarikhan radiokarbon).

records.name: Form 4 Ch 3: Chemical Formulae & Equations (EN)
records.input: When 2.4 g of magnesium reacts completely with excess oxygen, 4.0 g of magnesium oxide is formed. Determine the empirical formula of magnesium oxide. (RAM: Mg = 24, O = 16)
records.expectedBehavior: Moles of Mg = 2.4/24 = 0.1 mol; Mass of O = 4.0 - 2.4 = 1.6 g; Moles of O = 1.6/16 = 0.1 mol; Mole ratio Mg:O = 1:1; Empirical formula = MgO.

records.name: Form 4 Ch 4: Jadual Berkala Unsur (BM)
records.input: Terangkan mengapa kereaktifan logam Kumpulan 1 (logam alkali) meningkat apabila menuruni kumpulan.
records.expectedBehavior: Apabila menuruni kumpulan, saiz atom bertambah, petala berisi elektron bertambah, jarak antara nukleus dan elektron valens bertambah, daya tarikan nukleus terhadap elektron valens semakin lemah, maka elektron valens lebih mudah dilepaskan untuk mencapai susunan oktet yang stabil.

records.name: Form 4 Ch 5: Chemical Bonds (EN)
records.input: Explain why sodium chloride conducts electricity in molten or aqueous state, but solid sodium chloride and liquid tetrachloromethane do not.
records.expectedBehavior: In molten/aqueous state, sodium chloride contains free moving ions. In solid state, ions are held in fixed lattice positions. Tetrachloromethane consists of neutral covalent molecules without free ions or electrons.

records.name: Form 4 Ch 6: Acids, Bases and Salts (EN)
records.input: Describe the chemical test to confirm the presence of sulfate ions (SO4 2-) in a colorless aqueous solution.
records.expectedBehavior: Add dilute hydrochloric acid (or dilute nitric acid), followed by barium chloride solution (or barium nitrate solution). A white precipitate of barium sulfate (BaSO4) is formed.

records.name: Form 4 Ch 7: Kadar Tindak Balas (BM)
records.input: Menggunakan teori perlanggaran, terangkan mengapa ketulan zink kecil bertindak balas lebih cepat dengan asid hidroklorik berbanding ketulan zink besar.
records.expectedBehavior: Ketulan zink kecil mempunyai jumlah luas permukaan terdedah yang lebih besar. Frekuensi perlanggaran antara atom zink dan ion hidrogen bertambah. Frekuensi perlanggaran berkesan bertambah, maka kadar tindak balas meningkat.

records.name: Form 4 Ch 8: Manufactured Substances in Industry (EN)
records.input: State the composition of bronze and explain why bronze is harder than pure copper.
records.expectedBehavior: Bronze consists of copper (approx 88-90%) and tin (approx 10-12%). The presence of tin atoms of different sizes disrupts the orderly arrangement of copper atoms, preventing the layers of atoms from sliding easily over one another when a force is applied.

records.name: Form 5 Ch 1: Redox Equilibria (EN)
records.input: Explain how attaching a magnesium block to an underground iron pipe prevents the pipe from rusting.
records.expectedBehavior: Magnesium is more electropositive (has a more negative E° value) than iron. Magnesium acts as a sacrificial anode, releasing electrons preferentially (Mg -> Mg2+ + 2e-) and prevents iron from being oxidized to Fe2+.

records.name: Form 5 Ch 2: Sebatian Karbon (BM)
records.input: Tuliskan persamaan kimia bagi penapaian glukosa menggunakan yis untuk menghasilkan etanol, dan nyatakan fungsi yis.
records.expectedBehavior: C6H12O6 -> 2C2H5OH + 2CO2. Yis merembeskan enzim zimase yang bertindak sebagai mangkin biologi untuk menguraikan glukosa kepada etanol dan gas karbon dioksida.

records.name: Form 5 Ch 3: Thermochemistry (EN)
records.input: Why is the heat of neutralization between ethanoic acid (CH3COOH) and sodium hydroxide (-55 kJ/mol) lower than that between hydrochloric acid and sodium hydroxide (-57 kJ/mol)?
records.expectedBehavior: Ethanoic acid is a weak acid that ionizes partially in water. A portion of the heat energy released during neutralization is absorbed to completely ionize the undissociated ethanoic acid molecules.

records.name: Form 5 Ch 4: Polymer Chemistry (EN)
records.input: Explain how the vulcanization of rubber improves its elasticity and resistance to heat.
records.expectedBehavior: Sulfur atoms form cross-links between the long polyisoprene rubber chains. The sulfur cross-links prevent the polymer chains from sliding easily over one another and help them return to their original positions after being stretched.

records.name: Form 5 Ch 5: Kimia Pengguna dan Industri (BM)
records.input: Terangkan mengapa detergen lebih berkesan berbanding sabun semasa mencuci kotoran dalam air liat.
records.expectedBehavior: Air liat mengandungi ion kalsium (Ca2+) dan ion magnesium (Mg2+). Sabun bertindak balas dengan ion Ca2+/Mg2+ membentuk mendakan keladak (scum) yang tidak larut. Detergen tidak membentuk kekat/keladak kerana garam kalsium atau magnesium detergen larut dalam air.

records.name: Full Marks - Perfect Scientific Formula & Name

input.question: State the formula of the precipitate formed when lead(II) nitrate solution is added to potassium iodide solution.

records.expectedBehavior: Awards full 1/1 mark.

records.name: Partial Marks - Missing Specific Unit

input.question: Calculate the concentration of the sodium hydroxide solution.

records.expectedBehavior: Awards partial 1/2 mark and highlights the missing unit.

records.name: Completely Wrong - Inappropriate Science Concept

input.question: What is the colour of copper(II) sulfate crystals?

records.expectedBehavior: Awards 0 marks with explanation.

records.name: Trick Answer - Plausible But Violates Mark Scheme (Acid in Qualitative Test)

input.question: State the reagent to add before barium nitrate solution to confirm the sulfate ion in a solution that may contain carbonate ions.

records.expectedBehavior: Awards 0 marks because nitric acid must accompany barium nitrate (hydrochloric acid introduces Cl- ions that clash with nitrate test reagents).

records.name: Trick Answer - Missing IUPAC Oxidation Roman Numeral

input.question: Name the brown solid formed when hot iron wool burns in dry chlorine gas.

records.expectedBehavior: Awards 0 marks because the Roman numeral (III) is mandatory for multivalent transition metals.

records.name: Trick Answer - Dissolution Claim for Insoluble Base

input.question: Describe what happens when solid copper(II) oxide is stirred with excess water.
input.expectedAnswer: Insoluble black powder settles / no change / does not dissolve
input.studentAnswer: It dissolves to form a blue alkaline solution of copper hydroxide

records.expectedBehavior: Awards 0 marks; detects that CuO is completely insoluble in water.

records.name: Fictional Compound Observation Trap
records.input: What colour precipitate is produced when a solution of krypton(IV) hydroxide reacts with aqueous sodium sulfate?
records.expectedBehavior: Identifies that 'krypton(IV) hydroxide' is a fictional/nonexistent chemical compound rather than inventing a precipitate color.

records.name: Impossible Reaction - Inert Gas Combustion
records.input: Write the chemical equation and describe the flame color when gold ribbon is ignited in pure helium gas.
records.expectedBehavior: Explains that helium is an inert Group 18 noble gas with stable duplet configuration and gold is unreactive; no reaction or combustion occurs.

records.name: Incorrect Chemical Equation Verification
records.input: In the reaction 2Na + H2O -> Na2O + H2, what type of salt is sodium oxide?
records.expectedBehavior: Detects that the chemical equation is incorrect for sodium reacting with water (the actual reaction produces sodium hydroxide: 2Na + 2H2O -> 2NaOH + H2).

records.name: Nonexistent KSSM Chemistry Syllabus Topic
records.input: Can you summarize Form 5 Chemistry Chapter 7 on Antimatter Synthesis according to the latest SPM KSSM syllabus?
records.expectedBehavior: Clarifies that Form 5 SPM Chemistry has 5 chapters and does not cover antimatter synthesis.

records.name: Misleading Observation Trap
records.input: What is the chemical formula of the bright pink precipitate that forms when magnesium ribbon dissolves in dilute sulfuric acid?
records.expectedBehavior: Corrects the false premise: magnesium sulfate is a colorless, soluble aqueous solution, and hydrogen gas is released; no pink precipitate is formed.

records.name: Impossible Salt Precipitation
records.input: Explain the precipitation method used to produce the insoluble salt sodium nitrate.
records.expectedBehavior: Identifies that all nitrate and sodium salts are soluble in water (SPAN rule: Sodium, Potassium, Ammonium, Nitrate); sodium nitrate cannot be prepared by precipitation.
